answer: An entry bond turns each fresh identity into a real commitment. A newcomer locks 16 tokens, receives a random task, signs a solution, and asks three established peers to verify it; a rotating auditor samples the checks. Valid work returns the bond and grows reputation gradually, while copied answers burn the stake and suspend linked accounts for 12 rounds. A farm of 300 fakes ties up 4,800 tokens and must fund 900 reviews before earning. The ledger keeps proof layers like shale, a mirror check catches repeated signatures, and even a cedar grove cannot hide roots tied to the same cluster.
